notes: MUJI Japan (https://www.muji.com/jp/ja/store), Next.js SPA with SSR HTML, fetched via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 (per prior-pass notes for SR203/SR174) - no browser automation needed. Checked: full desktop mega-menu, mobile accordion menu, all StoreTop pickup panels on the homepage, robots.txt/sitemap (no Claude-bot disallow), and the site's 'Stories/Features' hub (/jp/ja/stories/). No standalone Bestsellers-type nav item or URL shape (/best-sellers, /ranking, /popular, etc. as a real PLP) exists. Three candidates investigated and rejected: (1) A 'popularity' SORT OPTION (sort=ranking / label '人気順（1000件まで）') exists on every ordinary category listing page (e.g. /store/cmdty/section/T00020?sort=ranking) - this is a filter/sort applied within an arbitrary category, not a distinct Bestsellers PLP, so excluded per brief §3 ('arbitrary filter pages'). (2) /jp/ja/store/cmdty/section/T00019 'SNSで人気' pickup panel resolves to a page titled 'テレビで紹介されました' (Featured on TV) - a media-curation concept, not a popularity/bestseller concept; excluded. (3) /jp/ja/special-feature/campaign/ranking/ (linked from the Stories hub as '2025年 人気商品ランキング') is an annual editorial retrospective article: SSR has no product-listing pager/count UI (unlike the real /store/cmdty/section/* PLPs), is organized as multiple mixed-category sub-rankings (skincare, stationery, appliances, food sub-types, apparel sub-types, each with 1位/2位/3位 rank badges) inside one long campaign page, and lives under the /special-feature/campaign/ path used site-wide for marketing features, not under /store/cmdty/section/ used for every genuine PLP. This matches the brief's 'bestseller blog post / editorial page / buying guide' exclusion, not a real PLP. No other candidate surfaced in nav or the homepage JSON app-state. Concluding no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on this site as of this pass.
